# ggwave source notice

WavePX uses ggwave as its physical data-over-sound modem. The Android WavePX
receiver vendors the minimal native decoder sources from ggwave tag
`ggwave-v0.4.0`, commit `e035c75be1916ed8c0d1a38e823981366da3971e`.

Upstream: <https://github.com/ggerganov/ggwave>

The adjacent `LICENSE` is the upstream MIT licence.
